articles.content: OAuth consent phishing never asks for a password. The attacker registers a multi-tenant application, sends the victim a link to the real login.microsoftonline.com authorize URL, and waits for the user to click Accept . Every step the victim sees is genuine, including MFA, which is why this attack class keeps working against organisations that think they are covered by phishing-resistant authentication. What matters is not who the user is, but what they just authorised an unknown app to do. This
